1.  The Petitioners have approached this Court for quashing FIR No.900/2020 dated 26.10.2020,
registered at Police Station Rajouri Garden for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC.
2.

The office report indicates that steps have not been taken for issuance of notice to Respondent No.2.
3.
As a last opportunity, one week is granted to the Petitioners to take steps for issuance of notice to Respondent No.2 through all permissible modes, including Dasti.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J SEPTEMBER 13, 2024 S. Zakir
